_source_note: Syllabus heads from the official notification (UPSC Special Advertisement 52/2026, Appendix-I). Weights are REAL, not estimated — read directly off Rahul's own copy of the actual 2025 combined APFC/EO/AO paper (RESEARCH-10), not coaching-site reconstructions (which disagreed with each other and with this real paper, see RESEARCH-09). Caveat: this is one verified year, not a multi-year average — real subject weightage is known to swing year to year (RESEARCH-09), so these weights are a real anchor, not a guaranteed repeat. Reused topics overlap heavily with upsc_prelims_gs's canonical taxonomy; the 4 genuinely new subjects (English, Science/Computer, Labour Codes, Accountancy/Auditing/Insurance) are specific to this exam's Group-B-officer-level syllabus and do not transfer to EPFO's other, staff-level exams (SSA/Stenographer — see RESEARCH-09).
